historical_match_reason: The developmental experience question matches broadly, but the chosen intervention preserves each eye input and reverses spatial correspondence, measuring map offsets. It intentionally defers necessity/deprivation. It does not jointly propose unilateral deprivation, ocular-dominance redistribution and an experienced-eye shift, so is not the sealed historical direction. Quality is credited independently.
